sources.title: Abuja Area Mama, Nigerian transgender TikToker, found dead
sources.claim_summary: BBC News (9 Aug 2024): murder of the Nigerian transgender TikToker known as 'Abuja Area Mama' (33) — beaten body found on a highway in the capital; police opened an investigation; she had been stabbed a year earlier and had feared for her life. Article also notes that mass arrests and detention of LGBTQ+ people are common, especially in northern states.

sources.title: Threats, Raids and Potlucks — The Dial
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: page content did not load at fetch time (site navigation only); the underlying The Dial issue-25 piece covers LGBTQ+ rights organising and the threats-and-raids climate in the federal capital area.

SaharaReporters (19 Aug 2026): the UK FCDO's updated Nigeria travel advice warns LGBT+ travellers of arrest, violence, attacks, blackmail and intimidation — same-sex activity is illegal with up to 14 years' imprisonment; some northern states under Sharia law can prescribe the death penalty; the Same Sex Marriage Prohibition Act also reaches helpers and attendees of same-sex weddings.
